dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures along the mid-lateral trunk exhibit irregular, non-uniform outer perimeters. These structures show a sharp, jagged gradient transition from the dark blue-grey base coat to a high-intensity light-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower lateral flank. These clusters are asymmetrical, lack internal dark cores, and are more densely grouped towards the anterior third of the body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent triangular relationship is formed by the centroids of three large macro-annuli in the central-lateral region. This is bordered superiorly by a series of four high-intensity blobs arranged in an arc following the dorsal curve.

other_distinctive_markers: A deep, transverse dermal fold is visible at the junction of the head and neck. The visible pectoral flipper displays a high-frequency punctate pattern that is significantly more compact than the markings on the main trunk.
